title: Prove exact nested broadcast cost with arbitrary auxiliary charts
body:
This scoped theorem proves the exact cost of broadcasting one scalar along any strictly nested terminal chain, even with arbitrarily many auxiliary chart ports. For every nondecreasing concave rank tariff H with H(0)=0, the minimum is the sum of H over adjacent terminal rank gaps. This resolves the extra-chart part of [PR #7790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7790)'s open question. **No new kappa** follows.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd282ce24fb3eea707f4342cecd1935ed367a1a3/research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum/PROOF.md) · [Exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd282ce24fb3eea707f4342cecd1935ed367a1a3/research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum/RESULT.json) · [Checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd282ce24fb3eea707f4342cecd1935ed367a1a3/research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum/verify.py) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd282ce24fb3eea707f4342cecd1935ed367a1a3/research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum/SOURCE-PINS.json) · [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19727662).

The information contract has one available source of an independent scalar. Every other terminal demands that scalar and has no initial information about it. Finite local linear operations, temporary storage, repeated messages and either transfer direction are allowed. Every cross-chart transfer is charged, and its endpoints must be strictly nested. Extra charts need not form a common chain. Shared broadcast, a second initial copy and joint delivery of different demands are outside this contract.

The proof relaxes each chart to its rank. Concavity permits each auxiliary vertex of a routing tree to move onto a neighbor and be contracted without increasing cost. The remaining terminal tree has minimum cost on the adjacent chain. This is an arbitrary-finite-size proof; the finite census below corroborates it.

For Clear1nsight's actual rooted binary route, chart ranks `0,4,6,7` still cost `H(4)+H(2)+H(1)`. The separate owner-411 bridge, root preparation, productive targets and all other costs remain outside this comparison. No whole-supplier optimum, physical free-storage claim or source kappa recertification is made. All five assumptions and the selected frontier are unchanged.

| Exact check | Coverage |
|---|---:|
| All labeled trees and integer placements through two auxiliary ports | 130,866 cases |
| Concave basis tariffs in each case | 9 |
| Independent tariff reconstructions | 512 |
| Exact contraction traces on integer, fractional and coincident positions | 11,664 traces; 23,328 contractions |
| Retained source replay | 462,400 scalar coefficients each orientation |

The census covers auxiliary ranks 0 through 9, including repeats. Its nine basis tariffs span every nondecreasing concave tariff on that grid. The proof covers any finite number of ports and all real ranks in the relaxation. A convex-tariff control gains from an extra port (21 to 13), while a free second copy changes the linear cost from seven to three. These examples show why the two hypotheses matter. Four rejecting controls and a disconnected-demand check pass.

Both registered CPython 3.12.16 modes pass in about 1.1 seconds each, standard library only. The unchanged 17-file source package runs first, including its actual rational chart containment, full forward/adjoint operators, independent packet expansion, root/bridge faults and dirty-retirement checks. Reuse of that suite is not a new independent implementation of its source audit. New census and contraction code is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers:

```text
PASS_NESTED_BROADCAST_AUXILIARY_OPTIMUM
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

AST parsing, tabnanny, whitespace, committed bytes/history/modes, official export/input checks and both serial read-only Git-free replays with an empty PATH pass. Exported hashes and modes remain unchanged. Timings show timeout headroom only. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44474647758/job/135392121951) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the new theorem and checker. His [fixed-port proof and audit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cae9a6b7fed315f704144f27a89bf9b0ad9fd6e/research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum/PROOF.md) supplies the source binding. Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied [PR #7786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7786)'s [rooted binary construction](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/binary/PROOF.md) and [source notice](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/NOTICE). The source is frozen at that exact commit; its live PR has since advanced. [Credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd282ce24fb3eea707f4342cecd1935ed367a1a3/research/nested-broadcast-auxiliary-optimum/CREDITS.md) preserves the full predecessor lineage. Concavity, Prufer codes and spanning-tree exchange are classical methods; no literature-wide priority is claimed.

Related [PR #7750](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7750) and [PR #7751](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7751) study original stock at nine different BIT deadlines, including new rational charts in the latter. Their information boundary and geometry are different, and neither theorem is consumed here. Current handoffs, fresh PRs and source/semantic searches show no observed competing claim in this scope. Cached searches are incomplete and not novelty certificates. The active rational sender-65 construction is unaffected.

The base is canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Only this research package is added. Earlier construction history, physical erasure, paired caller, ordinary compiler, finite stock, precision and outer services are not replayed. Lean and independent human/formal acceptance are unclaimed. The next useful questions change the available source information or specify a fully charged multi-value demand contract.
